name: pixel-buddy
description: An animated pixel Claude in place of the working dots, a HUD above the prompt, rotating tips and icon tool rows for the Claude desktop app.

user_name.title: Your name
user_name.description: The name the HUD greets you by, e.g. "Chào buổi sáng, Nam ☀️".

buddy_name.title: Buddy name
buddy_name.description: What the pixel Claude calls itself while it works, e.g. "Đệ đang cày…".

utc_offset.title: UTC offset (hours)
utc_offset.description: Your time zone for the HUD clock and greeting: 7 for Vietnam, 9 for Japan, -5 for New York.

show_spinner.title: Pixel Claude working row
show_spinner.description: Draw the pixel Claude at its laptop in place of the working dots.

show_hud.title: HUD above the prompt
show_hud.description: Show the band with greeting, folder, model, clock, turns and tool count.

show_tips.title: Rotating tips
show_tips.description: Replace the hint under the prompt with a tip that changes every two minutes.

show_tool_rows.title: Icon tool rows
show_tool_rows.description: Draw each tool call as one row with an icon, status and duration.
